evidence: A curated collection of prompts for [REA (Reverse Engineer Anything)](https://rea.tools/) — the toolset that lets your AI coding agent inspect how software works, from native binaries, firmware and kernels to games, Electron apps, APKs and websites.
Prompts are ready to paste into your agent. Replace everything in `<angle brackets>` and keep each request focused on **one feature** — narrow questions get evidence-backed answers.
Only analyze software you own or are explicitly authorized to test.
